property_summary: For any EOA player and any block parameters, a single play leaves the pot at 0 exactly when the drawn random bit is 0 (reference wins on bit 0) and at TICKET_AMOUNT (10) when the bit is 1; the mutant, which wins on bit 1, inverts this for every input, so the pot is wrong on every admissible play.
change_summary: Change the winning condition from `random == 0` to `random == 1`, flipping which plays trigger the payout and pot reset.
